sloka: एतस्य बाहुवीर्येण लङ्का सीता च लक्ष्मणः ।प्राप्ता मया जयश्चैव राज्यं मित्राणि बान्धवाः ।। ७.३५.९ ॥
transliteration: etasya bāhuvīryeṇa laṅkā sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ ।prāptā mayā jayaścaiva rājyaṁ mitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ ।। 7.35.9 ॥

translations.english: By the valor of Hanumān, I regained Lanka, Sītā, Lakshmaṇa, victory, my kingdom, friends, and relatives.
